params.name: bearing
params.label: Round
params.help: How far round from the ball, in the room's own sense of round.

params.name: elevation
params.label: Up
params.help: How far up from the ball. Past 90 goes over the top, which is how a head on a short bearing range reaches behind it.

params.name: width
params.label: Fan
params.help: How wide the heads are fanned across the room.

params.name: bars
params.label: Cycle
params.help: How long one time round takes, in bars. Musical, so it is right at any tempo.

params.name: sweep
params.label: Sweep
params.help: How far the fan swings; half the width when left out.

params.name: spread
params.label: Spread
params.help: Phase offset across the fixtures, in cycles. 0 moves them together; 1 spaces them evenly round one cycle.

params.name: rate
params.label: Rate
params.help: How many swings per cycle.

params.name: radius
params.label: Radius
params.help: How far out from the aim point it travels.

macros.name: size
macros.label: Size
macros.help: How far the route travels. 0 parks every head on the mirror ball.

macros.name: spread
macros.label: Spread
macros.help: Lags each head along its own route. 0 is unison, 1 spreads them evenly around one cycle.

macros.name: bearing
macros.label: Centre —
macros.help: Swings the whole look around the room.

macros.name: elev
macros.label: Centre |
macros.help: Drops or lifts the whole look. The safety taper still runs after this, so aiming down does not bypass it.
